description: This shell script sets up and runs performance tests for different variations of 'git diff' and 'git log' commands, focusing on 'diff --color-moved' features. It verifies Git revisions, sets environment variables, and executes performance tests with specific diff and log options.

methods.name: test_perf_default_repo
methods.description: Sets up the default repository state for performance testing.

methods.name: test_export
methods.description: Exports environment variables for use in tests.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a performance test with specified label and command.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.
